items.q: Is the Invisalign consultation really free?
items.a: Yes. The consultation and digital scan are free, with no obligation to start treatment.
No coupon or code needed. Just mention the free Invisalign consult when you book or call.
We accept cash and most PPO plans, and we check your benefits before your visit.
We are open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, and Dr. Lavi now sees new patients and treatment on Wednesdays as well.
Your ID and insurance card if you have one. We send our new digital intake forms ahead of your visit.
